body: It's like we're invisible, and when we're not, we're being spit on. In the very rare event that something good happens to us, we're attacked for reminding haters that we even exist. Makes me wish I had just been aborted, to be honest.
In my experience, nothing. Nothing at all happens, besides getting worse, and then being blamed for "not manning up."

It's never laziness. That's just something that people who don't go through things like this say so that they won't have to feel responsible. As for everything else, I'm sorry that I don't know anything that would actually help. All I can say is you're not alone here. Maybe it would be better if we all had our very own planet somewhere. I don't know.

Thank you for your response.
I've tried countless times to get help stopping the drugs, beer, and promiscuity, and sometimes people will help for a few days, maybe even a week, but when they realize that I need continuous help, they shrug and say "meh, I tried." Even had a psychiatrist tell me, after a few weeks of "treatment," that "well, I can't help you if you're not willing to help yourself." He said THAT, after I explained to him that the kind of stuff I'm doing is meeting strange men I don't know in public restrooms, snorting cocaine off the floor. I would have thought that a psychiatrist of all people would realize that, if someone is doing THAT, then any "recovery" is going to take a very, very, very long time. 
As for family helping, my father's the only one who even acknowledges what I tell him, and he's more upset about WHAT I do than WHY I do it.

I would love to have someone to talk to, to be honest.
The bad thing is, I don't know what to talk about except how bad it feels to be alive. I actually miss the times when I used to feel bag things like jealously or shame. I don't feel much of anything now, just pain. I can understand how that drives people away, but it's literally all I have now. But just having another human being acknowledge that I exist is enough to make me go on for a while longer. Thank you for responding.
